Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.loot

Class LootContainerFilledEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.ZentrixGameEvent
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.events.loot.LootContainerFilledEvent
public final class LootContainerFilledEvent extends ZentrixGameEvent
Called after Zentrix generated lazy loot for a container, once per pool.

For an opened container the loot is already in getInventory(), which listeners may edit directly - add, remove or replace items - before the player sees it. For a destroyed container nothing has dropped yet: getDrops() is the mutable list of items about to drop at its location. Appearance counters and the generation result are final either way; editing items does not give back or consume appearances of the pool's entries.

Main thread; only fired while a listener is registered.

Since:
1.8.0
